subject: Post-call recap: PHI handling boundaries, BAA availability, and hosting options for HealthOps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Julie Tan <julie@healthops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap: PHI handling boundaries, BAA availability, and hosting options for HealthOps

Thanks for your time this morning, Julie — quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call. I captured action items for both sides and flagged a few clarifying questions.

Key takeaways
- HealthOps will likely route limited PHI (patient name + dob + clinical notes snippets) to the inference layer for triage classification.
- You want a BAA in place and formal confirmation of our SOC 2 Type II status before any PHI is sent.
- Preferred hosting options to evaluate: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem package), or Hosted API with strong redaction + contractual constraints (only for pseudonymized flows).

Open questions (please confirm)
1) Do you require processing within a customer-managed VPC for all PHI workloads, or is a Dedicated instance with isolated tenancy acceptable?
2) Are there categories of PHI you can redact before sending? If yes, which fields must never leave your control?
3) Target timeline for procurement / legal review so we can prioritize BAA execution and account provisioning.

Next steps (proposed)
- HealthOps: complete the attached vendor security questionnaire and return by EOD next Thursday (attachment: healthops-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx).
- Redwood: share SOC 2 report and a draft BAA for review (I will start the DocuSign envelope once we confirm legal contact).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with Marissa to walk deployment options and network diagrams (I proposed Tue/Wed next week).

I copied Marissa and Laura to coordinate the technical and legal threads. If anything above looks incorrect or missing, let me know and I will update the plan.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: healthops-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 8 pages)

From: Julie Tan <julie@healthops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@healthops.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T10:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PHI handling boundaries, BAA availability, and hosting options for HealthOps

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- HealthOps' initial POC will include patient name, DOB and short clinician notes (under 500 chars). We can pseudonymize patient identifiers in many flows, but name+dob are sticky for our matching.
- We do require a signed BAA before any PHI is processed outside our environment. Can you confirm Redwood's legal can accept a mutual BAA (we have slight edits to standard language)?
- SOC 2 Type II report is required (redacted is OK), and we need the date range for the report to include the last 6 months.

I've attached our version of the vendor questionnaire (HealthOps_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx) and marked questions that are blockers for procurement. Can you review and return with answers? Also please indicate whether Hosted API can be used for PHI if we commit to field-level redaction + contractual controls — or whether Dedicated/Private is mandatory.

Timeline: procurement would like to kick off legal review this week and finish by Dec 10 if feasible.

Julie
Julie Tan
Director, Platform Security | HealthOps
julie@healthops.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T11:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PHI handling boundaries, BAA availability, and hosting options for HealthOps

Looping in some internal next steps and a recommended reply draft for Julie.

Internal notes / recommended stance:
- SOC2: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering the last 12 months; link is in related_links. Confirmed with compliance team.
- BAA: legal is willing to do a mutual BAA with reasonable redlines. I'll brief Legal (Laura) and start a draft; suggest sending the draft BAA to HealthOps and using DocuSign for signature.
- Hosting: for full PHI (name + dob + notes) our recommended production modes are:
  * Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) — full isolation and customer-managed networking; preferred for regulated flows.
  * Dedicated — isolated tenancy within Redwood with reserved capacity; acceptable if customer can accept provider-managed networking and we include contractual controls.
  * Hosted API — only acceptable for PHI if HealthOps commits to pre-send redaction or pseudonymization for the PII fields + we have an executed BAA and a narrow data-processing Addendum; advise this only for low-risk, non-identifying tokens.

Action items
- Marissa: schedule technical deep-dive (SE call) with HealthOps — suggest Tue 12/1 or Wed 12/2 morning PT.
- Laura: prep draft BAA and list of typical redlines we accept.
- Karthik: send SOC2 report link and a short customer-facing summary of hosting recommendations; propose DocuSign BAA envelope.

Suggested reply to Julie (short):
> Hi Julie — thanks for the note. We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (link below) and are happy to work through a mutual BAA. For production PHI we recommend Private or Dedicated deployments; Hosted API is possible only with strict redaction/pseudonymization and contractual limits. Marissa will run a technical walk-through next week. I'll kick off the DocuSign BAA and cc legal.

I'll own the SE scheduling and coordinate with Laura on the BAA.

Marissa
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment references: internal SOC2 link (redwood-soc2-report-2027.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PHI handling boundaries, BAA availability, and hosting options for HealthOps

Julie — quick confirmation and next steps from Redwood: 

1) SOC 2 report: attached is a redacted copy of our latest SOC 2 Type II (redwood-soc2-report-2027.pdf). The report window covers Mar 2026–Oct 2027.
2) BAA: Laura will send a draft mutual BAA (attached draft-BAA-HealthOps.docx) and we will open a DocuSign envelope here: https://na1.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123xyz. Please confirm your preferred legal contact for routing.
3) Deployment recommendations: 
   - Private deployment (VPC or on-prem): recommended for full PHI — provides customer-managed networking and max isolation.
   - Dedicated: acceptable for PHI if contractual controls and reserved tenancy are sufficient for your compliance team.
   - Hosted API: only recommended for pseudonymized or redacted data; not for direct patient identifiers unless we have a narrow DPA and BAA and you accept the associated constraints.

4) Technical call: Marissa will reach out to schedule the SE deep-dive — proposed slots Tue 12/1 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 12/2 09:00–10:00 PT.

Please return the completed questionnaire (attached earlier) and confirm the legal contact for the BAA. We can target contract execution and account provisioning in the 2–3 week window if procurement moves quickly.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2027.pdf (redacted), draft-BAA-HealthOps.docx (Draft BAA)
